L6·N7732unmasked layer
Fires on nouns/pronouns used as ordinary referential mentions — e.g. "your **Lord**/**angels**", "your kitties", a name followed by "**is**" — and is strongly *suppressed* by the same words in vocative direct address ("Dear Lord,", "O mind,", "My Lord,"), so it essentially signals "referential, not being addressed."

This neuron keys on the verb (or its immediately following word) in formulaic, courteous first-person communicative statements — "we will **say** more", "we were privileged **to** meet", "I was fl**attered**", "we cordially invite", "we **send** our sympathy", "I write **this**", "X **announces**" — i.e. the performative-announcement/gratitude slot right after a subject pronoun, with the strongest responses being large negative (suppressing) ones.
